messages:
Rae: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's regional failover drill. Success but uncovered recurring issues: route convergence blindspots, inconsistent restore steps, and runbook edit churn. Dropping succinct action items and owners.

Sam: Routing. Observed ~18s tail on some prefixes; traffic-swap assumes fast BGP convergence. We need a converge metric + gating (delay final swap until p95 < 4s for 30s). Owner: Sam. Due: 2026-08-01. Ticket: INF-700.

Jun: Backups/restore. Restore was manual and used shared creds. Propose a sandboxed one-click restore job with ephemeral creds + checksum verify. Owner: Jun. Due: 2026-07-25. Ticket: INF-701.

Ivy: Runbook/process. Runbook edits during drills created confusion. Suggest repo pin (infra/playbooks), require branch-per-change and 2-approver rule for DR playbook, plus changelog entries. Owner: Ivy. Due: 2026-07-20. Ticket: INF-702.

dr-bot: failover-drill-2026-07-30: summary posted; follow-ups INF-700, INF-701, INF-702 created.

Rae: Minimal preflight snippets to include in runbook (put under "preflight"):
```
# list recent backups
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/prod/ | tail -n 3
# checksum verify
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/{{RESTORE_ID}} - | sha256sum
# sandbox restore (ephemeral creds)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/key.json --iam-account=dr-sandbox@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/key.json
rdb restore --from s3://redwood-backups/prod/{{RESTORE_ID}} --to cluster=dr-sandbox --namespace=dr-test-$(date +%s) --verify
```

Sam: ack. I'll add routing.converge_ms histogram, dashboard, and gating logic. Will attach dashboard JSON to INF-700.

Jun: ack. I'll prototype the Jenkins job for sandboxed restore and ensure it never uses prod creds; logs will go to s3://dr-verifications/. Linking INF-701.

Ivy: ack. I'll update infra/playbooks README, add branch protection, and include a PR template reminding authors to add changelog entries. Linking INF-702.

Rae: Noting recurring pattern: label/config drift and shared-credential restores have happened in 3 of last 5 drills. Tickets above should address systemic fixes. Scheduling a 30m validation sync two weeks after due dates. Closing thread; tickets hold details. If more items appear drop them here and dr-bot will append.
